description: Create and deploy a new HL7 message processing channel in NextGen Connect Integration Engine. The channel should be named 'Patient Admission Channel', accept HL7 v2.x messages on TCP port 6661 using MLLP framing, and write received messages to files in /tmp/hl7_output/. After creating the channel, deploy it so it is actively listening for messages. You can use the terminal window to interact with the system. The REST API is available at https://localhost:8443/api (credentials: admin/admin). The web dashboard at https://localhost:8443 shows channel status after login. Note: The web dashboard is monitoring-only and cannot create channels. All REST API calls require the header 'X-Requested-With: OpenAPI'. Channel XML must include a <responseTransformer> element in destination connectors or deployment will fail silently.
